name: Martialist’s Quarterstaff

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Four charges (1d4 back at dawn): Searing Smite (2 charges, DC 13), a charge to throw it and have it fly back, or a charge for Advantage and a shove Prone.
text: This quarterstaff has 4 charges and regains 1d4 expended charges each dawn. While holding it you can spend 2 charges to cast Searing Smite (save DC 13). When you take the Attack action you can spend 1 charge: until the end of your next turn the staff has the Thrown property (range 20/60 feet) and flies back to your hand after each throw. When you make a melee attack with it you can spend 1 charge to have Advantage on the roll; if it hits, the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw or has the Prone condition.

powers.name: Throwing Grip
powers.text: 1 charge as you attack: until the end of your next turn it can be thrown (20/60 ft) and flies back.
